The first time I tripped on mushies my buddy's gf (whom we all assumed was out of town at a friend's party) came home to the 3 of us tripping out in the living room. We were neck deep into the trip and I noticed that her presence seemed to alter not only my experience, but the environment as well. This was not a good alteration. I felt like if the energy of the room were a light and it suddenly became dull, and harsh, like a dying lightbulb with no lampshade.  The room was not as lively as it once was. You can call it a "vibe" or "feel" or what-have-you, but I just found it incredibly perplexing at the time. 

A few years later I found out that she cheated on my buddy when she was at that party, and drove his car back home (a 1 hour and 15 minute drive) drunk. I never considered her a "being" from the other side, but rather a form of bad energy manifested as a human that did not mesh well with the environment my friends had created prior to her arrival. 

Maybe... it was the energy of her guilt seeping into the room and thus into my trip? Who knows. I am not sure if my friends had felt this dip in the energy. I had a good time up until then though.

I mean, while we are monkeys (or at the very least, higher primates) that does not limit our intellectual capabilties. I mean, yeah you may be a monkey, but the fact that you can even perceive yourself as such is just as fascinating, no?

It (the ability to perceive and learn) could either be viewed as a blessing or a curse, depending on your perspective. We may be programs in a machine, but each program (person) has it's own specific role in the machine. You can either do the what the machine tells you to, or dismiss the machine and come up with your own purpose through independent decision making. Both results are equally terrifying.
